name: acrovault
description: AcroVault is a tool for looking up Acronyms

scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p ./platform/chrome/src && cp -r src/* ./platform/chrome/src && cp -r icons ./platform/chrome/ && cp index.html ./platform/chrome/
scripts.build:firefox: mkdir -p ./platform/firefox/src && cp -r src/* ./platform/firefox/src && cp -r icons ./platform/firefox/ && cp index.html ./platform/firefox/
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
